name: echo-gui
description: Echo desktop app: live meeting transcription + insights (Electron front-end for the Python echo-server sidecar)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,main,preload,electron -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:preload" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on -l tcp:5174 file:dist/main/main/main.js file:dist/preload/preload/preload.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electronmon .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
